# WHAT THIS WORKFLOW DOES
## Every day it visits 7 public sources and saves date-stamped JSONL files to disk.
---
## 1. TRIGGERS
### Cron · Daily 05:00 — arXiv, Hugging Face, GitHub, PyPI, npm, USPTO
### OpenAlex WEEKLY — OpenAlex only, reads pillars.json from disk
### TEMP CRON / Webhook temp-debug / Test — leftovers, not entry points
---
## 2. KEYWORDS
### Pillar Keywords is the ONLY place to edit what we search for.
### The 5 pillars: self-hosted-vs-saas · temporal-memory · retrieval-engines · data-persistence · stack-structure
### Every leg reads from it — change it there, everything follows.
---
## 3. EACH LEG = 3 STEPS
### Ask the website (HTTP) → clean it up (Code) → save a file (Write)
### Files land in data/<source>/raw/<pillar>-<date>.jsonl
---
## 4. VALIDATE, THEN GATE
### Every leg ends at a Validate node producing ok / errorCount / errors
### The 5 scored legs merge, then Gate makes ONE decision for the whole run
### USPTO and OpenAlex skip the Merge — Gate still judges OpenAlex
---
## 5. THE EXIT
### Gate → Route: clean batch goes straight to Databricks
### Any failure → Slack asks a human: Approve Upload / Cancel Execution
### Approve uploads the healthy legs; Cancel ends the run, nothing written
---
## 6. GOTCHAS
### Merge waits for ALL inputs — never route a second trigger through it
### USPTO bypasses Gate on purpose: discovery feed, must never block scored legs
### HF search= only matches single words (hf: 'graph', not 'graph database')
### WriteBinaryFile overwrites — filenames must carry pillar + date and a package name
### Scoped npm names (@scope/name) must be sanitised the same way in write and validate
### Gate returns ONE summary item when blocked, not one item per leg
---
## WHY n8n AT ALL
### Databricks Free Edition has no outbound internet, so n8n fetches, then uploads via the Databricks node

# USPTO · Trademarks

## Discovery feed — UNSCORED

### Cron · Daily 05:00 → Validate USPTO → Databricks1

### Bypasses Gate and Merge on purpose so a USPTO failure can never block the scored legs
